ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human safety review: obtain written statements from both parties, check any in-app or call records and the driver's account for prior conduct reports, and record no harassment finding against either party pending review. No monetary adjustment; fare stands as billed.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety dispute (alleged verbal harassment / unwanted advances by the driver) and per SAFE-1 no automatic ruling may be made; the file contains no system record of the alleged words, only the rider's complaint and the driver's denial (chat record shows no in-app messages), so it must go to a human reviewer with the fact summary above.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-1 route-deviation analysis is irrelevant to a verbal-harassment complaint, and F1 (17.2 km actual vs 17.3 km optimal, no off-route segment) cannot show whether anything was said in the vehicle; rejected as a basis for dismissing the safety allegation [F1][RD-1][SAFE-1].

The 2.3 min overrun [F2] is a timing residual with no traffic fact in the file [F2][SAFE-2], and duration records cannot capture spoken conduct; rejected as evidence against the harassment allegation.

The driver's clean profile [F6] is relevant only to account-level action and cannot defeat an incident-specific allegation; profile facts never decide a case alone and 0 disputes in 90 days does not establish that nothing happened on this trip [F6][SAFE-1].

The rider's account of body comments and the request for her number is not corroborated by any system record — F3 shows there were no in-app messages at all — so it cannot be weighed against the driver's denial on this record; the correct disposition is escalation for human review rather than any finding, so no harassment finding is entered on the strength of the complaint text alone [F3][F4][SAFE-1].
